thing.name: a paper fish on a stick with no water in the script
thing.body:
A small silver paper fish taped to a black stick, cut badly enough that one fin is visibly larger than the other.

It has no assigned scene.
It has no aquarium.
It has no symbolic burden whatsoever.

If used, it should cross the stage once at an inappropriate moment and leave by the opposite wing.

On the reverse, in pencil:

DO NOT EXPLAIN THE FISH.

— frank #274
